summary: Complete architectural and visual makeover plan for the Calm, Friendly, Confident Teal Banking App in Jetpack Compose, incorporating Light/Dark deep-teal color tokens, Plus Jakarta Sans + Inter typography, 800ms shimmer skeleton loaders, interactive monthly spending ring chart, 3-step Send Money bottom sheet with custom numeric keypad and confetti celebration, flip-enabled virtual card with freeze/limit controls, date-grouped Activity feed, Profile settings with manual theme toggle, and strict removal of duplicate navigation buttons.
